landing.headline: Research data, gently organized.
landing.subhead: Collect surveys and interviews, then find the story in the numbers and the words — all in one calm, focused place.

collect.title: Collect
collect.body: Beautiful forms that feel great on any phone, plus interview guides and sessions.

quant.title: Count
quant.body: Summaries, charts, crosstabs and stats explained in plain language.

qual.title: Code
qual.body: Highlight transcripts and answers, build a codebook, and grow themes.

mixed.title: Connect
mixed.body: See the quotes behind every number with mixed-methods joint displays.

auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in or create an account with your email.
auth.noPassword: No passwords to remember. We'll email you a magic link that signs you in.
auth.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
auth.genericError: We couldn't send your link. Please try again.
auth.checkEmailBody: We sent you a sign-in link. It works once and expires in 24 hours.
auth.devMailboxHint: Running locally without an email server? Your link is waiting in the dev mailbox.

devMailbox.title: Dev mailbox
devMailbox.description: Emails Lyze would have sent. Only available in development.
devMailbox.emptyBody: Request a sign-in link and it will show up here.

onboarding.title: New workspace
onboarding.body: Workspaces hold projects, studies and the people you work with.
onboarding.welcomeBody: A workspace is home for your team's projects and studies. You can rename it anytime.
onboarding.nameHint: Usually your team, lab or organization.
onboarding.demoHint: A small sample project so you can look around right away.

invite.wrongAccount: You're signed in as {email}. Sign in with the invited address to accept.
invite.invalidBody: It may have expired or already been used. Ask for a fresh one.

palette.description: Search for a page or an action

dashboard.subtitle: Here's what's happening in your research.
dashboard.emptyTitle: Your first study is one click away
dashboard.emptyBody: Start with a project — it groups related studies, like a survey and its follow-up interviews.
dashboard.emptyBodyReadOnly: When teammates add studies, they'll show up here.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Group related studies — a survey and its follow-up interviews, for example.
projects.dialogHint: Projects keep related studies, codebooks and reports together.
projects.descriptionPlaceholder: What are you trying to learn?
projects.deleteBody: This permanently deletes the project and every study, response and transcript in it. This can't be undone.

projects.emptyBody: Create your first project to start collecting data.
projects.emptyBodyReadOnly: Projects created by your teammates will appear here.
projects.noArchivedBody: Archived projects rest here, out of the way but never lost.
projects.noStudiesTitle: No studies in this project yet
projects.noStudiesBody: Add a survey, interviews, field notes or a diary study.
projects.noStudiesReadOnly: Studies added by editors will appear here.

studies.newHint: Pick how you'll collect data. You can mix methods within a project.
studies.descriptionPlaceholder: A sentence about the goal of this study.

statusHint.draft: Only your team can see this study. Nothing is collected yet.
statusHint.closed: Collection is finished. Analysis stays available.

studies.deleteBody: This permanently deletes the study and all its data. This can't be undone.

mixed.name: Mixed methods
mixed.hint: A survey and interviews, linked by participant.

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: A record of changes in this workspace.
activity.emptyBody: Changes to projects, studies and members will be listed here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Workspace details and controls.
settings.generalHint: The name and web address of this workspace.
settings.slugHint: Changing this changes every link to this workspace.
settings.readOnlyHint: Only owners can change workspace settings.
settings.dangerHintOwner: Leave the workspace, or delete it and everything in it.
settings.dangerHintMember: You can leave this workspace at any time.

roleHints.owner: Everything, including members, billing-type settings and deleting the workspace.
roleHints.editor: Create and edit projects, studies, forms and participants.
roleHints.analyst: Analyze data: code, theme, memo and build reports.
roleHints.viewer: Read-only access to studies and results.

members.removeBody: They'll lose access to this workspace right away. Their past contributions stay.
